### Coverage Summary

**Verified**: Entity field definitions, form rendering, save/load logic, three display surfaces (card, table, CSV), and live calculations all checked. Spec requires `תקרה מחייבת = תקרה לפי 3 חודשים > תקרה לפי שליש ? ... : ...` (max of two ceilings). Generated code has ternary skeleton but with wrong operands (_v[5] vs _v[7] instead of _v[6] vs _v[7]) and wrong return type (status labels instead of numeric values). Field rendered as input instead of computed. Not checked: runtime interaction with appStore, validation flow (requires Flutter).
